slides.title: No vehicles after 6 p.m.
slides.body: Only ambulances are exempt. People may not move after 8 p.m., the Tigray caretaker administration said (via Wazema, Nov 18).

slides.title: Gatherings banned
slides.body: Meetings and gatherings of more than four people are banned across the zone, including Shire town. The curfew is indefinite.

slides.title: Gold mining halted
slides.body: Mining operators were ordered to leave the zone, and security personnel told to hand in weapons, with a Nov 23 deadline (ACLED).

slides.title: Border tension continues
slides.body: DW and ACLED reported Ethiopian heavy equipment moving toward the Eritrean border Nov 19-20 (per Critical Threats). Not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Pursue dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Wazema Radio, Nov 18; Critical Threats, Nov 20, 2026
